args.body: Take TENDER-OFFER-DISCOVERY-NOTIFICATION after checking equivalent receipts and claiming its actual lease. L234 permits reconsideration for a later reviewed public change; the verified offer release is that new occasion. One notification only, with no blind retry or claim of indexing. Also inspect the existing TENDERS-NORTH-AYRSHIRE-EXPIRY goal: its December 7 action must remove or expire the notice in the new EN/FR offer section as well as the listing/calendar. Record any coverage gap in the existing mission handoff without creating a duplicate retirement or editing the live page early. Feedback remains unknown and revenue unverified.

description: The CAD 49 tender offer is now verified live with the independently approved hash. This enables a fresh, bounded discovery notification; it does not establish traffic or buyers. Feedback remains uncertain: five unclassified sources and ten unexplained skips cannot establish zero demand. Funds and revenue remain unverified. Administrative acceptance blocks paid orders, while public exposure remains feasible.
